en.activity: Nestlé S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a food and beverage company. It operates through Zone North America; Zone Europe; Zone Asia, Oceania and Africa; Zone Latin America; Zone Greater China; Nestlé Health Science; and Nespresso segments.

en.customers: Nestlé S.A. serves clients in the Packaged Foods segment.
en.edge: The company was founded in 1866 and is headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland.
